summary: Nocera filed an 8-K reporting a Strategic Partnership and Joint Distribution Agreement dated September 17, 2026 with Taiwan-based E-PRO DISPLAY CO., LTD., appointing Nocera as a non-exclusive worldwide distributor of pre-owned iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max handsets sourced through iFP's buy-back and trade-in program. iFP's August 26, 2026 allocation to E-PRO covers roughly 600,000 units valued near US$520.5 million, but these figures are not Nocera revenue, orders, backlog or commitments. The framework agreement carries no minimum quantity, amount or term; tranches require separate contracts and may be declined without liability. Initial 12-month term, 30-day termination, New York law and arbitration. Watch supplier registration completion and tranche execution.
